name: Xorothian Empowerment raises party and raid attack power by 5% (#1205)
contract: Xorothian Empowerment 704994 reads 'Increases the attack power of all party and raid members $s1%. Does not stack with similar effects.' (installed moa_description: '5%'). Both effects use SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65), TargetA 1 (TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, auto-expanded to nearby group members by SpellAuras.cpp's area-aura handling via Acore::AnyGroupedUnitInObjectRangeCheck), RadiusIndex 287 (100 yards). Effect 0 is native aura 166 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACK_POWER_PCT), effect 1 is native aura 167 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_RANGED_ATTACK_POWER_PCT), both EffectBasePoints 4 with DieSides 1 -> resolved 5, verified via csv.DictReader against /home/fab/CoaServer/reference/snapshots/ascension-data/tables/spell.csv.gz. Their dispatch-table entries are AuraEffect::HandleAuraModAttackPowerPercent (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:231) and AuraEffect::HandleAuraModRangedAttackPowerPercent (:232) -- confirmed at exactly the cited lines, both real native generic AP-percent auras consumed by Unit::UpdateAttackPowerAndDamage. This is the same native effect/aura-type pair already used as the fix template for Hellbringer (apps/coa-gameplay-test/scenarios/knight-of-xoroth-hellbringer-raid-damage.json, #3911) -- nothing in AscensionXorothContracts.cpp touches 704994. NOT covered: the tooltip's 'does not stack with similar effects' clause needs a cross-spell spell_group exclusivity entry outside this single spell's scope, per the same documented limitation as Hellbringer.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle

Force the Xorothian Empowerment raid aura
Let the area aura propagate to the grouped ally
SETUP: the caster carries Xorothian Empowerment
CONTRACT: the raid area aura reaches the grouped ally
CONTRACT: the ally's attack power rises by ~5%
CONTRACT: the ally's ranged attack power rises by ~5%
